description.value:
You fill the space around you with divine flames that protect allies within it and burn away those who mean you harm, especially from unholy and technological threats. You and allies in the area are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed]. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]].

Enemies beginning their turn in the area take 10 fire damage, become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 1} if they have the tech trait, and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] for 1 round if they have the unholy trait.
